svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: About 7.3 m of 12.7 x 1.2 stainless tube, bent into a serpentine in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: three layers. Each straight run is 310 long between bends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All bends 38 radius (a standard 1/2 in hand bender): runs and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: layers 76 apart. Top layer 212 above the box floor, six runs;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle layer 136 up, six runs; bottom layer 60 up, five runs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Water goes in at the top layer, left end, 190 behind the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and out at the bottom layer, right end, 152 in front: the gas

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rises past colder and colder tube (counterflow).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The layers join with short risers at the left end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lower the bank into the open box onto the support bars, then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: connect each end to its bulkhead union in the end wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: pressure test with water; no run touches the walls.
